# Verification report fixtures

The scalar candidate and certificate/replay documents come from the retained
validated-numerics evidence in fcmaes-rust at `c5a83e21484892c2c72b4c5c282ae72d1c44b753`.
The test helper synthesizes timings, arms, checker-input identities and
rejection cases around them. Its command copies a receipt and does not run a
checker. These test reporting semantics and artifact binding; they are not
new scientific executions or proof evidence. The certificate example separately
runs the real pinned Julia verifier and fresh replay through the native runtime.
